summary: Option B Crypto Treasury (Wallet Ledger + Audit Chain + Snapshot + Onchain) - BACKEND 18/18 NEW PASS; FRONTEND verified end-to-end. Wallet config returns 6 wallets; overview & ledger filtering (coin/tx_type/pagination) work; send-batch (OxaPay->Binance) creates correct batch_out+batch_in+fee rows and balances move exactly by amt+fee/amt-fee; convert(BTC->USDT@60000) decreases from_coin by 0.001 BTC and increases to_coin by 59.5 USDT (after 0.5 fee); cashout creates cashout + bank_deposit pair with net (1000-5=995) AED into Wio; expense create with method='Binance Pay' + paid_in_usdt=true debits BINANCE USDT by 25; PATCH expense (25->30) re-flows ledger (delta -5); DELETE expense restores full 30 USDT; /api/chain/search?q=<recharge_code> returns counts and chain {customer, invoice, recharge, ledger_entries}; /api/snapshot/daily returns opening/activity/closing per wallet+coin; /api/onchain/verify/btc/<hash> returns no-5xx with network='btc'. Frontend /wallets renders 6 wallet cards (CRYPTO/EXCHANGE/BANK/MANUAL pills) with live balances exactly matching the backend (OXAPAY 2378.21 USDT, BTCPAY 1.06293472 BTC, BINANCE -1005 AED/0.0389 BTC/108.5 USDT, OKX 0.00453 BTC, WIO 995 AED/-50 USDT, MANUAL 9 ETH), top-action buttons Send Batch / Convert / Cashout to Wio present, ledger table renders with coin/type filters & Apply. /audit-chain page renders with data-testid='audit-chain-input' + 'audit-chain-submit'; searching 'RCH-2605-00088' returns counts {ledger:0, recharges:1, ...} and renders Customer + Invoice + Recharge panel with TX hash & copy button + right side counters for Recharges/Customers/Ledger/Expenses. Sidebar has Wallet Ledger and Audit Chain links. Existing pages (Dashboard, Customers, Recharges, Invoices, Treasury, Expenses) load without regression (Recharges shows pre-existing 'Mismatch' badges - by design).

issues: Search input placeholder on per-wallet ledger panel is clipped/overflowing inside the right-aligned input ('Search tx hash, batch, cu...') - consider widening or shortening placeholder.

When chain has 0 ledger entries (e.g. Manual-gateway recharge with mismatched TX), the Ledger entries panel says 'None' which is correct but could be more descriptive ('No on-chain movements linked to this recharge yet').

action_items: (Optional) Pre-existing backend_test.py::TestRecharges and TestTreasury fixtures use stricter-than-current payloads and fail because the service now requires 'AED rate and AED value at payment time' on crypto recharges and 'OKX deposit TX hash' - update fixtures or accept as expected behavior (these are NOT regressions from the Wallet Ledger rebuild).
(Optional UX) Widen the ledger panel search input or shorten its placeholder so it doesn't clip.

(Optional) Clean up the 6 TEST_ ledger rows created during this run (external_ref OXA-BIN-260527-6888, BIN-CONV-..., CASH-..., plus the -50 USDT WIO_BANK row from a previous run). Migrator on next startup will repopulate the real 86 deposits but will not auto-remove these manual TEST rows.
critical_code_review_comments: WalletsService.sendBatch correctly creates a balanced pair (batch_out negative on source + batch_in positive on dest = received_amount), tags ledger_ids with linked_batch_id for traceability and writes a separate FEE row on the source when fee_amount > 0. Verified mathematically: 50 USDT send w/ 1 USDT fee => source -51, dest +49.

WalletsService.convert correctly handles same-wallet from->to via convert_from + convert_to with rate_used persisted; optional fee row added in fee_currency. Verified: 0.001 BTC * 60000 - 0.5 fee = 59.5 USDT in.
WalletsService.cashout writes cashout (negative AED on source) + bank_deposit (positive net AED into WIO_BANK). Verified: 1000 AED with 5 AED fee => Wio +995 AED.
ExpensesService.update calls wallets.removeExpenseLedger then recordLedger, achieving idempotent re-record. Verified end-to-end with PATCH amount 25->30.
ExpensesService.delete also removes linked ledger rows so balances are properly restored. Verified.

ChainController.search composes the 5-table search (ledger/recharges/invoices/customers/expenses) and conditionally builds a chain payload when exactly one recharge matches OR a ledger row links to a recharge. Good. Edge: when ledgerRows[0] has linked_recharge_id but multiple recharges also matched, the chain still gets built from ledger - acceptable.
SnapshotController.daily uses opening = sum(amount before start) and adds day activity grouped by tx_type. Closing recomputed deterministically as opening+ins+outs. Correct.
OnchainController gracefully degrades on rate-limit by returning {ok:false, error} instead of 500. Confirmed by test (status < 500).
Migrator backfills 86 recharges into wallet_ledgers on startup - verified by overview totals matching production figures.

Frontend WalletLedger.jsx uses data-testid='wallet-card-*' on all 6 cards and surfaces Send Batch / Convert / Cashout to Wio buttons. AuditChainSearch.jsx uses data-testid='audit-chain-input' and 'audit-chain-submit'. Good test coverage.
Minor: WIO_BANK shows -50 USDT balance from a leftover TEST ledger row created by a previous run - should be cleaned up before delivery.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the new flows (Wallet Ledger page renders 6 cards with live balances, Audit Chain search renders chain with customer/invoice/recharge/ledger panels, sidebar has both new links, existing pages still load)
